title: Taking an initial segment
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states, and let $P$ be a property of work-tape head positions. Suppose a run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time before $t$, and satisfies $P$ at every time through $t$. For any natural number $u\le t$, the run from $a$ reaches its configuration at time $u$ after $u$ steps, avoids $F$ at every earlier time, and satisfies $P$ at every time through $u$.
hypotheses_covered: The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
The state at every time strictly before $t$ is outside $F$
The work-tape head positions satisfy $P$ at every time at most $t$
